properties.headline: Flood Warning issued September 9 at 10:36AM EDT until September 11 at 11:00PM EDT by NWS Tampa Bay Ruskin FL
properties.description:
...The National Weather Service in Tampa Bay Ruskin has issued a
Flood Warning for the following rivers in Florida...

Alafia River At Lithia affecting Hillsborough County.

Little Manatee River At Wimauma at US 301 affecting Hillsborough
County.

Manatee River Near Myakka Head at SR 64 affecting Manatee County.

Horse Creek Near Arcadia at SR 72 affecting DeSoto County.

.Heavy rainfall expected this week will bring some local rivers into
Flood Stage.

* WHAT...Minor flooding is forecast.

* WHERE...Manatee River near Myakka Head at SR 64.

* WHEN...From late tonight to Friday evening.

* IMPACTS...At 11.0 feet, Private road and bridge 1 mile downstream
flood. Agricultural, rural Kibler area begins to flood.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...
- At 9:15 AM EDT Wednesday the stage was 7.1 feet.
- Bankfull stage is 7.0 feet.
- Forecast...The river is expected to rise above flood stage just
after midnight tonight to a crest of 11.8 feet early tomorrow
afternoon. It will then fall below flood stage Friday afternoon.
- Flood stage is 11.0 feet.
- Flood History...This crest compares to a previous crest of 11.8
feet on 08/05/1969.
- https://www.weather.gov/safety/flood
properties.instruction:
Turn around, don't drown when encountering flooded roads. Most flood
deaths occur in vehicles.

Caution is urged when walking near riverbanks.

Additional information is available at www.weather.gov.

The next statement will be issued this evening at 1145 PM EDT.

properties.headline: Flash Flood Warning issued September 9 at 6:52PM MST until September 9 at 9:45PM MST by NWS Tucson AZ
properties.description:
FFWTWC

The National Weather Service in Tucson has issued a

* Flash Flood Warning for...
West Central Cochise County in southeastern Arizona...

* Until 945 PM MST.

* At 652 PM MST, Doppler radar indicated thunderstorms producing
heavy rain in the Whetstone and Fairbank area. Between 1 and 2
inches of rain have fallen. Flash flooding is ongoing or expected
to begin shortly.

HAZARD...Flash flooding caused by thunderstorms.

SOURCE...Radar indicated.

IMPACT...Flash flooding of small creeks and streams, urban areas,
highways, streets and underpasses as well as other poor
drainage and low-lying areas.

* Some locations that will experience flash flooding include...
Whetstone, Huachuca City, Fairbank and Charleston.

This includes the following highways...
Route 90 between mile markers 300 and 313. Route 80 between mile
markers 306 and 313. Route 82 between mile markers 49 and 67.

This includes the following streams and drainages...
Slaughter House Wash, Middle Canyon Wash, Babocomari River,
Escalante Wash, San Pedro River, Walnut Gulch, Willow Wash and
Clifford Wash.

properties.headline: Flood Warning issued September 9 at 11:51AM CDT until September 10 at 9:00PM CDT by NWS Lake Charles LA
properties.description:
...The Flood Warning is extended for the following rivers in Texas...

Pine Island Bayou Near Sour Lake affecting Hardin and Jefferson
Counties.

For the Pine Island Bayou...including Sour Lake...Minor flooding is
forecast.

* WHAT...Minor flooding is occurring and minor flooding is forecast.

* WHERE...Pine Island Bayou near Sour Lake.

* WHEN...Until Thursday evening.

* IMPACTS...At 25.0 feet, Water inundates roads in lowland areas near
the river. Low spots on Old Sour Lake Road are under water.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...
- At 10:45 AM CDT Wednesday the stage was 25.8 feet.
- Bankfull stage is 22.0 feet.
- Recent Activity...The maximum river stage in the 24 hours ending
at 10:45 AM CDT Wednesday was 26.2 feet.
- Forecast...The river is expected to fall below flood stage late
tomorrow morning and continue falling to 19.9 feet Monday
morning.
- Flood stage is 25.0 feet.
- Flood History...This crest compares to a previous crest of 25.9
feet on 05/20/1994.
- http://www.weather.gov/safety/flood
properties.instruction:

through flooded areas.

properties.headline: Special Marine Warning issued September 9 at 10:23PM EDT until September 9 at 11:00PM EDT by NWS Key West FL
properties.description:
SMWKEY

The National Weather Service in Key West has issued a

* Special Marine Warning for...
Gulf Waters from East Cape Sable to Chokoloskee 20 to 60 nm out and
beyond 5 fathoms...

* Until 1100 PM EDT.

* At 1023 PM EDT, a strong thunderstorm was located 12 nm west of
Gulfside 10 Reef, moving west at 5 knots.

HAZARD...Wind gusts 34 knots or greater.

SOURCE...Radar.

IMPACT...Expect wind gusts in excess of 34 knots, suddenly higher
waves, frequent lightning, and heavy downpours.

* The strong thunderstorm will remain over mainly open waters.
properties.instruction:
Prepare for wind gusts in excess of 34 knots, steep and fast-building
seas, frequent lightning, and blinding downpours. Stay low or go
below, and make sure all on board are wearing life jackets.

properties.headline: Severe Thunderstorm Warning issued September 9 at 7:23PM MST until September 9 at 8:15PM MST by NWS Tucson AZ
properties.description:
SVRTWC

The National Weather Service in Tucson has issued a

* Severe Thunderstorm Warning for...
West Central Cochise County in southeastern Arizona...
East Central Pima County in southeastern Arizona...

* Until 815 PM MST.

* At 723 PM MST, a severe thunderstorm was located near Benson,
moving southwest at 10 mph.

HAZARD...60 mph wind gusts.

SOURCE...Radar indicated.

IMPACT...Expect damage to roofs, siding, and trees.

* Locations impacted include...
Benson and Mescal.

This includes the following highways...
Route 90 between mile markers 290 and 296. Route 80 between mile
markers 293 and 298. Interstate 10 between mile markers 288 and 307.
properties.instruction:
Seek shelter inside a well-built structure and stay away from
windows. This storm is capable of producing damaging winds.

Wind damage with this storm will occur before any rain or lightning.
Do not wait for the sound of thunder before taking cover. Seek
shelter immediately inside a sturdy structure and stay away from
windows.
